use IO.Std.write_line

numeric(text: string) -> bool is
    let parsed mut = 0.0

    return double.try_parse(text, parsed ref)
si

for candidate in ["1", "-3", "2.5", "1e6", "", " ", "0x10", "hello"] do
    write_line("\"{candidate}\": {numeric(candidate)}")
od

"1": True
"-3": True
"2.5": True
